reference_roles: Existing warden-b and scout-a: style and registration only.
fixer-a-master for b/c: garment and registration only, not identity.

prompts.a:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production source for a 192x192 layered pixel-art recruit portrait in a dark first-person dungeon crawler.
Input images: two existing recruit portraits are STYLE AND FRAMING REFERENCES ONLY, not identities to copy.
Primary request: a new distinct adult male camp Fixer, a shrewd middle-aged trader with a narrow weathered face, a high receding hairline, sparse dark hair slicked behind the ears, a thin uneven moustache, hooded attentive eyes and a restrained knowing half-smile. Practical, slightly shabby and persuasive; no warrior styling.
Composition: one square transparent canvas, a single head-and-shoulders bust. Match the references' head scale and placement: slight three-quarter turn toward image right, eyes at about 36% canvas height, mouth at 51%, chin at 65%, top of hair at 8%, shoulder base at 98%. Whole head/ears visible, fully covered linen collar and plain faded brown padded jerkin. A narrow worn leather satchel strap crosses the lower chest with a small closed ledger tucked under it and a tiny dull-brass purse clasp. Keep these at the bottom, clear of neck and face. No hands.
Style: restrained hand-painted pixel art, readable native 192px clusters, fine dark contours, broad material planes, desaturated earth colours, about 48 colours. Match the existing recruit references, avoid painterly blur and high-detail photorealism.
Lighting: neutral local form shading, diffuse ambient illumination. No directional torch glow, orange lighting, rim lights or scene background. Illumination will be added as a separate runtime pass.
Constraints: alert OPEN eyes and CLOSED resting mouth; natural face not exaggerated caricature. No teeth showing, no scars across eyes, no jewelry, helmet, weapons, money symbols, text, border, background or watermark. Genuine transparent alpha outside the bust.
